entities.name: Strefan Maurer
entities.description: Progenitor of the minor Maurer vampiric bloodline who rules a remote region of Stensia.

entities.name: Stensia
entities.description: Region where Strefan rules the outland valleys.

entities.name: Shilgengar
entities.description: Demon who pacted with Strefan and helped create the twelve bloodlines.

entities.name: Sigarda
entities.description: Angel whose forces Strefan repelled and whose knights he massacred.

entities.name: Tatyana
entities.description: The only woman Strefan has loved.

entities.name: Hladvora
entities.description: Shadowy creature that invaded the Maurer estate and attacked Strefan.

entities.name: Brandt
entities.description: Vampire hunter used by the Hladvora.

events.summary: Strefan, obsessed with immortality, forged a pact with the demon Shilgengar and murdered his brother Sergei.
events.quote: This obsession ultimately led him to murder his brother Sergei Maurer and drink his blood

events.summary: Strefan, with Edgar and Olivia, worked with Shilgengar to create the twelve vampire bloodlines.
events.quote: to create the twelve bloodlines of vampires on Innistrad through Shilgengar's Ritual

events.summary: Strefan attacked Heron's Light Hold and massacred Sigarda's knights, forcing her to flee.
events.quote: He attacked Heron's Light Hold and massacred Sigarda's knights, forcing her to flee.

events.summary: Strefan killed his rival Irska Dusken and scattered the Dusken bloodline.
events.quote: Strefan killed his rival Irska Dusken and scattered the remainder of the Dusken bloodline.

events.summary: The Hladvora lured Strefan back to the Maurer estate via Brandt and attacked him; his fate is unclear.
events.quote: Strefan's fate after the battle is unclear.
